Battery-grade copper foil, used as the anode-current collector in lithium-ion cells, is a major factor behind this demand. As India builds more factories and moves toward large-scale production, the need for high-purity, ultra-thin copper foil will rise. results.title: Battery Pack Tariffs: What OEMs Need to Know in 2026
results.content:
Multiple tariff measures took effect simultaneously. A 93.5 percent tariff on Chinese graphite – the primary anode material in virtually all lithium-ion batteries – took effect, representing one of the most significant raw material tariffs in US manufacturing history. A 30 percent baseline tariff on all Chinese goods compounded the impact on battery cells and pack components sourced from China. Steel and copper tariffs of 50 percent added further cost pressure on pack housings, connectors, [...] The first step for any OEM that has not done this recently: audit the entire battery pack bill of materials for tariff exposure by component, by HTS code, and by country of origin. Many OEMs are surprised to find that their “Korean” battery pack contains Chinese graphite, Chinese BMS components, or Chinese-origin copper. A complete tariff audit often reveals that strategic substitution of two or three components can dramatically reduce total tariff exposure without requiring a full redesign. [...] Key Context: The Supreme Court struck down tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) in February 2026, but the administration continued pursuing battery-related trade barriers through other legal authorities including Section 232 investigations, while maintaining existing measures including a 10 percent import surcharge under Section 122. The regulatory environment remains fluid.
